title: identity.SamlSettings
description: SamlSettings are the saml connectivity settings

appId.description: AppID is the Azure application ID.

audience.description: Audience specifies the SAML audience used in the verification of the SAML response.

cert.description: Cert is idp certificate in PEM format.

consoleURL.description: ConsoleURL is the external Console URL that is used by the IDP for routing the browser after login.

enabled.description: Enabled indicates whether saml settings are enabled.

groupAttribute.description: GroupAttribute is the name of the group attribute.

providerAlias.description: ProviderAlias is the provider alias used for display.

skipAuthnContext.description: SkipAuthnContext indicates whether request authentication contexts should be skipped.

tenantId.description: TenantID is the Azure Tenant ID.

common.Secret.description: Secret Stores the plain and encrypted version of a value. The plain version is not stored in a database

encrypted.description: Specifies an encrypted value of the secret.

plain.description: Specifies the plain text value of the secret.

identity.SamlType.description: SamlType represents the type of a SAML configured settings
